create_assets_config_from_env: create an AssetsConfig instance by reading ASSETS_BASE_URL and ASSETS_STORAGE_ROOT from environment variables
create_s3_config_from_env: create an S3Config instance by reading S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID and S3_REGION_NAME from environment variables
create_cache_config_from_env: create a CacheConfig instance by reading CACHE_MONGO_DATABASE and CACHE_MONGO_URL from environment variables
create_common_config_from_env: create a CommonConfig instance by reading COMMON_HF_ENDPOINT and COMMON_BLOCKED_DATASETS from environment variables
validate_storage_protocol: validate a string with is_storage_protocol to check if it is a valid file or s3 storage protocol
